g.text: USB-only supply does not power the external LED rail.

g.desc: USB-only supply does not power the external LED rail.

g.text: Direct GPIO16 data; check 3.3V acceptance on the actual LED batch.

g.desc: Direct GPIO16 data; check 3.3V acceptance on the actual LED batch.

g.text: Lens left / flat down / leads right: DIN, 5V, GND, DOUT.

g.desc: Lens left / flat down / leads right: DIN, 5V, GND, DOUT.

g.text: All board labels retained; unused pads marked X.

g.desc: All board labels retained; unused pads marked X.

g.text: Module boxes show external terminals only. Layout is schematic; physical footprints are not assigned.

g.desc: Module boxes show external terminals only. Layout is schematic; physical footprints are not assigned.

g.text: Select 4 / 6 / 8 / 10 switches and calibrate fitted taps. SW11 uses functional pin names; verify chosen encoder terminal order.

g.desc: Select 4 / 6 / 8 / 10 switches and calibrate fitted taps. SW11 uses functional pin names; verify chosen encoder terminal order.

g.text: 0-10k per input. Bias HIGH in resistor mode; high impedance in pot / disabled / boot.

g.desc: 0-10k per input. Bias HIGH in resistor mode; high impedance in pot / disabled / boot.

g.text: Pot: outer legs RING / SLEEVE; wiper TIP. Variable resistor: TIP to SLEEVE; RING unused.

g.desc: Pot: outer legs RING / SLEEVE; wiper TIP. Variable resistor: TIP to SLEEVE; RING unused.
